name: Restaurant Invoice Ingest: PDF -> Price Audit

parameters.content:
RESTAURANT INVOICE PRICE AUDIT

1. Gmail PDF attachment OR POST webhook restaurant/invoice
2. Extract invoice line items (PDF text / JSON body)
3. Read Price_Book sheet
4. CODE compares matched SKUs (no AI)
5. AI only for unmatched line items
6. Flag variances >2% -> append Invoice_Audit status=pending_review

Human QA gate before disputing distributor charges.

options.systemMessage: You help restaurant operators map distributor invoice lines to contract price book SKUs. Return only JSON. Use match_status=ai_suggested when confident, new_item when no match exists. Never invent contract prices.

parameters.content: Gmail without PDF attachments is ignored.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: true, audit_id: $json.audit_id, status: "pending_review", flagged_line_count: $json.flagged_line_count, total_overcharge: $json.total_overcharge } }}
